content.title: 30 Short hairstyles for women over 60
content.text: Is your hair beginning to feel flat, dull, and lifeless? If you’re over the age of 60 – don’t worry, you’re not alone! As we age, the structure and health of our hair is compromised massively, and it often feels like there’s nothing we can do about it! If you’re wanting beautiful, bouncy locks then a short hairstyle could be the answer to all your hair woes. Short hairstyles are a great option for women over 60 who are wanting to reboot and breathe some life back into their hair, leaving it looking thicker and healthier. So, what are you waiting for? RUSH’s expertise in styling mature hair will help you to choose the right short hairstyle for your face shape and personal style, so let’s break down our favourite short hairstyles for women over 60… BOOK NOW Classic Short Hairstyles 1. Pixie Cut A pixie cut is one of the most popular short hairstyles for women over the age of 60 – thanks to its versatility, convenience and look. Pixie cuts are loved for their edgy nature and can often take years off your appearance. They’re easy to style and work for almost any hair type. As we get older, the structure of your hair will become fragile, so a pixie cut would help your hair to look healthier, thicker and younger! 2. Classic Bob Classic bobs are a great way to shake up your look – without losing too much length, and the bonus is that you can rock them at almost any age! They’re timeless, elegant, and glamorous. The classic bob will help maintain your hair’s health and they go with almost any style. 3. Layered Bob This cut is all about texture! Layers can texture and movement to quite a basic haircut – giving yourself and your hair a new lease of life! Adding long layers throughout your bob will give the illusion of thicker hair, and if styled correctly, a layered bob can take years of your appearance! We’d recommend styling with a round brush to add some bounce to your bob! 4. Asymmetrical Bob An asymmetrical bob is a wonderful option for adding a youthful touch as it complements the face’s features. This cut draws attention to the face through the bob’s slanting shape, framing the face beautifully. 5. Textured Crop Wispy, layered, textured crops are perfect as they accentuate the face’s features. This cut can be elevated with bangs to harmonise your face shape and feature. Modern Short Hairstyles 6. Long Pixie Cut A long pixie cut or a ‘bixie’ are a unique take on the pixie cut, being known for their adventurous nature. With short hair being all the rage on social media, the bixie will be becoming a lot more popular over the next few years! As you age, the structure of the hair is weakened so shorter cuts will help your hair to look healthier and fuller. 7. The Butterfly Cut This cut consists of short face-framing layers that swoop outwards – a gorgeous look for if you’re wanting to add a youthful touch. The butterfly cut gives carefree energy, being one of the number one looks on the trend forecast for 2025. 8. Blunt Bob A super sleek blunt bob is stylishly chic and a bold look to shake up your style. This look accentuates the face’s features. Adding a few long layers will add texture and dimension to the look, whilst complementing the face’s natural angles and your gorgeous face structure. 9. Tapered Cut Tapered Cuts are loved for their sleek and elegant appearance. This cut looks great on women over 60 thanks to their low maintenance and effortless nature! 10. Choppy Layers This cut is all about texture! Choppy, layered cuts can be elevated with a set of bangs to give a playful vibe. If you’re wanting to achieve a more youthful, boho look, then choppy layers are the one for you! We’d recommend adding texturizing spray to boost your volume. 11. Curly Pixie Cut A curly pixie is the height of playfulness. A curly pixie cut could be a great way to shake up your style due to its versatility – it can be both youthful and edgy. We’d recommend trying a pixie cut if you’re wanting to accentuate your face’s features! 12. Curly Bob This is a take on the classic bob – a curly bob. This cut is the height of sophisticated and the added texture and definition of the curls only elevate this look. The curly bob will make you stand out and draw attention to your features. 13. Short Afro Short afros are a bold and beautiful look for women over the age of 60 – it’s time to let your natural hair texture shine! Curls can have an energising effect on your look and their dimension can add fullness to your face for a more youthful glow! 14. Finger Waves Finger waves are an elegant and vintage looking choice for women over the age of 60. This look became popular in the 1920s and 1930s – finger waves are a hairstyle that shapes the hair into S shaped patterns, evokes old Hollywood glamour. 15. Wavy Lob Beachy, wavy lobs are so dreamy! Beach waves add depth and dimension to the face, whilst encapsulating the cut’s relaxed and youthful vibe. This cut will have you feel like you’re living in an endless summer! Short Hairstyles with Bangs 16. Pixie with Side-Swept Fringe A pixie cut with a side-swept fringe is a fantastic way to refresh your look, offering versatility that can be both youthful and edgy. If you’re looking to highlight your facial features, we suggest giving this style a try. 17. Bob with Blunt Fringe A bob with a blunt fringe is a bold way to shake up your appearance as the bluntness of the bob will complement almost any face shape and accentuate your face’s features. This is the ultimate cut if you’re looking for a chic and sophisticated look. 18. Layered Cut with Wispy Fringe A layered cut with a wispy fringe is perfect to accentuate your face’s features. This cut can be elevated with wispy bangs to harmonise your face shape and feature. This cut consists of short face-framing layers that swoop outwards – a gorgeous look for if you’re wanting to add a youthful touch. 19. Short Shag with Fringe A short shag with a fringe is a trendy and edgy style to shake up your look – and it’s one of the most popular looks of 2024. This boho look will definitely turn heads! 20. Cropped Cut with Baby Fringe A cropped cut with baby fringe is a playful and unique look if you’re wanting to try something different. As you age, your hair’s structure weakens, so opting for shorter cuts can make it appear healthier and fuller. Edgy Short Hairstyles 21. Mohawk Pixie This edgy and daring cut will have you living your punk rock fantasy well into your 60s! For this look, hairspray will be your best friend and you’ll need plenty of it if you’re wanting to perfect your spiky do! 22. Spiky Crop Spiky crops are a fun and energetic way to spice up your look. This cut is all about texture and dimension, making the hair looking thicker and fuller – something that over 60s find themselves needing more! 23. Undercut Pixie An edgy undercut paired with a pixie is a modern and daring choice if you’re wanting to stay young at heart. If you’re wanting to spice up the basic pixie cut, then this is for you! This cut will take you back to your rebellious teenage years – it really helps you to stand out in the crowd. 24. Mini Mullet Mullets aren’t reserved specifically for men – many women can rock the mullet! For those who want to add a youthful glow to their look, the mullet can be a great way to spice up your look – adding volume to sometimes flat looking hair. 25. Textured Faux Hawk Faux Hawks are known for their individuality, as well as their bold and youthful appearance, making them perfect for women over 60. Whilst this cut is more daring, it will help you to stand out in the crowd! For this look, pomade will be your best friend and you’ll need plenty of it if you’re wanting to perfect your quiff! Elegant Short Hairstyles 26. Sleek Bob For this look, the hair will fall past the jawline, hugging the face, which will accentuate the face’s features. This polished look is loved for its sleek and timeless nature – and an added bonus is it’s very low-maintenance. 27. Soft Curls Soft curls can suit you at almost any age – and they will always look glamourous. This style is loved for its romantic, timeless appeal and can be easily achieved by using heatless curls. 28. Smooth Crop A short crop is a beautiful choice for women who are ageing, as it lets their natural beauty shine. This refined look has been very in demand in salons due to its timeless nature – this is a look that will never go out of style. 29. Short Bob with Volume A short bob with volume can be achieved through layers and looks great on those over 60. This is due to the layers adding texture and dimension to the cut, which is especially handy if you have thin or fine hair. 30. Classic Tapered Cut A Classic Tapered Cut is a timeless, clean hairstyle that provides a polished, neat look that’s easy to maintain, making it a popular choice for both casual and professional settings. Suitable for all hair types, it’s ideal for anyone seeking a sharp, low-maintenance haircut. Understanding Hair Changes in Your 60s As you age, your hair care needs evolve. Ageing comes with a whole host of problems for your hair – the texture becomes drier, the density becomes weaker, and your hair begins to go grey. Women over 60 face challenges with their hair, such as thinning, dryness and grey hair. Thin hair requires a bit more attention as the strands are so fragile, but how do you take care of thinning hair? Thin hair is delicate and prone to damaging, meaning that shampooing too often can dry out your hair, making it more brittle, which leads to hair loss, shedding and breakage. Also, make sure to turn down the temperature when you’re washing your hair as hot water strips your hair of its natural oil, leaving the hair feeling and looking dried out. We’d also recommend getting more frequent trims, they are especially crucial for those with fine hair. Trimming the hair allows the hair to grow healthier, whilst leaving your hair looking fuller. Our experts are experts in mature hair and they’re here to bring your hair dreams to life. FAQ's Fine hair is a main culprit of getting older – we’d recommend trying shorter cuts to add fullness to the hair. We’d recommend using hairspray or a texturizing spray to add volume to your cut!We’d recommend getting a trim every 6 – 8 weeks to keep your hair looking fresh and remove any split ends. Whilst colour can cover your grey hair, sometimes it is best to let your natural hair colour shine as you age.As you grow older, your hair can become thinner so a shorter hairstyle may be the best option if you’re wanting thicker, healthier looking hair. Shorter hairstyles can knock years off your look – giving the illusion of thicker, healthier, fuller hair. A fringe is a great option for those over 60 as it can hide wrinkles and draw attention to the face’s features.
